articles.title: Vuelta a España: Matthew Brennan scores second sprint victory on stage five
articles.summary: Visma-Lease a Bike dominate final stages to set up Briton. Mads Pedersen dropped on category-three climb. The British rider and Grand Tour debutant Matthew Brennan of Visma-Lease a Bike sprinted to a second stage victory of the Vuelta a España in Roquetes.
body: Wout van Aert and Christophe Laporte expertly led out their 21-year-old teammate at the end of stage five, and the youngster again demonstrated his devastating speed with a confident victory to conclude the 173.4km route from Falset. Brennan has two victories from two sprint opportunities at the final Grand Tour of the season.

Jordi Meeus (Red Bull–Bora–Hansgrohe) was second and Vincenzo Albanese (EF Education–EasyPost) third on the day, while Tadej Pogacar (UAE-Team Emirates XRG) safely maintained his commanding 3min 21sec general classification lead.

A five-rider breakaway escaped early: Walter Calzoni (Pinarello Q36.5), Stefan Küng (Tudor), Mattia Gaffuri (Picnic PostNL) and Diego Uriarte (Equipo Kern Pharm) joined Fredrik Dversnes (Uno-X Mobility) at the front after the Norwegian rider attacked solo.

Küng soon dropped back to the peloton, leaving a four-man breakaway, but they were caught by the chasing bunch with around 100km remaining. It was Lidl-Trek who upped the pace and shut the escapees down on a blowy day when crosswinds and potential splits in the bunch were a concern.

articles.title: Chelsea in talks with Emiliano Martínez’s camp and braced for Enzo Fernández bid
articles.summary: Experienced goalkeeper wants to leave Aston Villa. Manchester City expected to push for midfielder. Chelsea have been offered Emiliano Martínez and are considering making a bid for the goalkeeper.
body: Martínez has told Aston Villa he wants to leave but a move to Juventus collapsed last week after Villa had signed his replacement, Zion Suzuki, from Parma for £30m.

Goalkeeper has been a problematic position for Chelsea in recent seasons, with Robert Sánchez mainly the No 1 but prone to mistakes. Mike Penders, 21, is being lined up to become the first-choice keeper, but the new Chelsea manager, Xabi Alonso, selected Sánchez for Monday’s win against Fulham and two Sánchez errors led to goals.

The availability and offer of Martínez has intrigued Chelsea and they are mulling whether it is too good an opportunity to turn down. The 33-year-old is a vastly experienced serial trophy winner. He won the World Cup in 2022 and reached the 2026 final. He also lifted the Europa League with Villa last season and the FA Cup with Arsenal in 2020.

Martínez was not in the squad for Villa’s heavy opening-weekend defeat at Brighton. Marco Bizot started in goal, with Suzuki on the bench. Chelsea are discussing with Martínez’s camp about the terms of a deal that would solve both clubs’ problems.

articles.title: Wawrinka given late wildcard for US Open farewell
articles.summary: Stan Wawrinka will make a farewell appearance at the US Open - despite initially not being given a wildcard for the final Grand Slam of his career.
body: Stan Wawrinka says his US Open triumph will "forever be one of the greatest moments of my life" after missing out on a wildcard for a farewell appearance in New York.
The 41-year-old will retire at the end of year and was given a wildcard for this year's Australian Open and Wimbledon, while reaching the French Open main-draw on ranking.
He reached the third round in Melbourne and lost a pair of entertaining first-round matches in Paris and Wimbledon respectively.
The US Open has received some criticism for its decision not to award a wildcard to 2016 champion Wawrinka, who did not enter qualifying despite being inside the cut-off.

articles.title: Fury v Joshua uncertainty will be resolved next week, insists Frank Warren
articles.summary: Promoter says negotiations are subject to a time limit. ‘They won’t let it go past the end of next week’ Frank Warren believes that the tortuous negotiations surrounding the proposed fight between Anthony Joshua and Tyson Fury are subject to a time limit which will run out by the end of next week.
body: “Nothing’s been signed off as yet,” Warren said in regard to a revised contract for Fury and Joshua to fight in New York. “Everybody’s talking and talking rather than getting on with the business and getting it done. I think it will happen and if it doesn’t, and I think there’s a time limit on it, by the way, it will be one of those fights that slipped by.

“If it happens, I think it will be in November and, in all probability, in the States. Tyson went over the weekend to Miami, which is where he’s training. So one way or another, he’s going to fight in November. Hopefully, it’s against AJ.”

Asked about the time limit, with Joshua and his promoter Eddie Hearn wanting more money from the US promoters Zuffa Boxing now that the bout is being moved to the US, Warren said: “I should think they won’t let it go past the end of next week.”

articles.title: PWR attendances rise by 23% after World Cup
articles.summary: Premiership Women's Rugby says average attendances rose by 23.4% during the 2025-26 season, which concluded in June with Saracens winning a record fourth title.
body: The numbers have been aided by the boost the sport received by England winning a home World Cup at Twickenham in September 2025 and come despite the departure of United States star Ilona Maher from Bristol Bears.
Maher, who is the most followed rugby union player in the world on social media, generated unprecedented attention for the league during her stint in Bristol during the 2024-25 campaign.
The league also reported a 132% increase in social media following, a 310% growth in its database and more than 111 million views across YouTube, Meta and TikTok - a 174% increase in viewing figures.
Last season was the first during which every PWR match was broadcast live across platforms including TNT Sports, BBC Sport and YouTube.

articles.title: Uefa set to drop Fifa tournament boycott threat
articles.summary: Uefa is set to drop its threat of boycotting Fifa competitions, having received assurances there will be no repeat of Gianni Infantino's plan to sell off stakes in the World Cup to private investors, BBC Sport has been told.
body: The matter will be discussed at a meeting of Uefa's executive committee in Monaco on Thursday.

Earlier this month, European football's governing body said that despite Infantino's plan being aborted following widespread condemnation, the conditions required to prevent a boycott had "not been met".
"Assurances have to be made that such attempts to disfigure the game in this way will never be made again," Uefa insisted.
That came after Infantino had told national member associations that the FFE proposal was "now off the table", and apologised for "errors".

articles.title: Yankees' Luis Gil Thriving In New Role In Minor Leagues
articles.summary: Luis Gil has not pitched much for the New York Yankees this season and has spent a chunk of the season injured. Gil did not start the season on the Opening Day roster by design. He was activated and made four starts before he was optioned again.
body: He came off the injured list on August 11 and made a couple of rehab starts for High-A Hudson Valley before going back to Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre. However, in his latest return to Triple-A, he has been working out of the bullpen.

articles.title: Chelsea in contact over move for Villa goalkeeper Martinez
articles.summary: Chelsea consider a move for Aston Villa goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez after making contact with the Argentina international's representatives.
body: The 33-year-old is considered available for a potential transfer from Villa after the club signed Japan goalkeeper Zion Suzuki from Parma for about £30m earlier this month.

The move could provide another opportunity for Chelsea and Villa to do business. Chelsea signed forward Morgan Rogers from Villa for a club-record £117m, while Alejandro Garnacho moved in the opposite direction on an initial loan deal.
Striker Nicolas Jackson, valued around £65m, could also join Villa and be reunited with his former manager, Unai Emery.

The clubs are known to have a close relationship. They were also involved in a deal widely described as a "PSR swap", which saw defender Ian Maatsen join Villa and Omari Kellyman, who is now at Strasbourg, move to Chelsea.

articles.title: Olympian Alysa Liu Announces Figure Skating Break to ‘Fine-Tune Things,’ Vows ‘I’ll Be Back’
articles.summary: Olympic gold medalist Alysa Liu is taking a break from the ice. Liu, 21, revealed her plans to sit out the 2026-27 figure skating season in an Instagram post shared Tuesday, Aug. 25.
body: “To my supporters, while people are announcing programs, imma take this time to announce that I will not be competing this season,” wrote Liu.

“I always want to challenge myself in new ways, so my artistry & skating can evolve,” she continued. “It’s important to me that my sport reflects my personal growth. I’m gonna take the time to recalibrate, fine-tune things & whatnot.”
She also promised to return, telling her followers, “So fear not, I’ll be back, & in the meantime I’ll be rooting for my teammates near & far.” Liu concluded her post, “See yall soon!!”

Liu made her Olympic debut at the 2022 Beijing Winter Games, before announcing her retirement later that year. She, however, returned to compete at the 2026 Milan Winter Games this past February, taking home the gold in both the women’s singles and team events.

articles.title: Athens Indoor Football League team unveils its name, logo
articles.summary: A new professional sports team in Athens revealed its name and logo on Wednesday. Georgia sports legends David Pollack and Brian Jordan along with Pittsburgh Steelers Hall of Famer Jerome Bettis announced their Indoor Football League team earlier this year.
body: “Powerful, aggressive, and uniquely connected to Athens, Crush represents a hard-hitting football team while also paying tribute to R.E.M.’s iconic song Orange Crush. It’s a modern sports brand with local roots and national appeal,” the franchise said about the name.
The team is set to debut in 2027 and will play its home games at the Akins Ford Arena at the Classic Center.

The IFL formed back in 2008. The league currently consists of 14 teams split among an Eastern and Western Conference. The Athens team is expected to be in the Eastern Conference while a new team in San Jose, Calif. will be in the Western.

articles.title: FIA confirms Mercedes granted engine upgrades despite Red Bull complaints
articles.summary: The FIA has confirmed that Mercedes have been granted the opportunity to make upgrades to their engine despite protestations from rival teams.
body: Following the introduction of all-new engines for the 2026 season, Formula 1's governing body implemented an Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities (ADUO) system, designed to allow manufacturers to catch up to the performance of the leading power unit during the rules cycle.

It was revealed in June after the first round of performance assessment, which included the first five rounds of the season, that the FIA had adjudged Red Bull to have the strongest engine and had granted upgrades to Mercedes, Ferrari, Audi and Honda.
The FIA never revealed their findings to the media, but teams and drivers confirmed the outcome publicly, while a document revealing the results was also leaked.

The ruling was seen as controversial because the consensus in the paddock was that Mercedes, whose works team had won the first six grands prix of the season, were being given an upgrade, while Red Bull, who had managed just a single podium in that time, would potentially lose more ground to their rivals.

articles.title: Solheim Cup captain Nordqvist announces shock mid-season retirement
articles.summary: Solheim Cup captain Anna Nordqvist has announced via social media that she will retire from playing professional golf after this week's FM Championship, live on Sky Sports.
body: The three-time major winner will captain Team Europe at Bernardus Golf from September 11-13, having featured in each of the previous nine Solheim Cups as a player and been part of five winning teams.

Nordqvist has been a playing vice-captain in the last two contests but quickly ruled herself out of juggling captaincy with playing against Team USA in the Netherlands, despite still regularly featuring on the LPGA Tour and impressing in the majors.

The 39-year-old remains inside the world's top 120 and sits in the top 75 on the Race to CME Globe standings, although has now confirmed her intention to call time on her glittering playing career before the end of the LPGA Tour season.
In a post shared by the LPGA Tour and Ladies European Tour, Nordqvist said: "It's with a grateful heart I am retiring from playing professional golf in Boston this week."

articles.title: New event and big changes revealed in revamped 2027 PGA Tour schedule
articles.summary: The PGA Tour has confirmed its schedule for the 2027 FedExCup season, running from January to August and featuring numerous changes from previous years.
body: Eight Signature Events will feature in a 36-tournament schedule, with the season starting at The American Express in California from January 21-24 and finishing at the Tour Championship from August 26-29.

The only new addition is the Sompo Championship, which will be the penultimate event of the regular season from July 29-August 1, while the PGA Tour's Greensboro tournament has been rebranded from the Wyndham Championship to the GO by Raymond James.

A change to the Florida Swing sees The Cadillac Championship will now played from March 4-7 at Trump National Doral, the week before The Players, with the Arnold Palmer Invitational taking place from March 18-21 instead.
All other Signature Events remain the same and include the top 50 players from the previous year's FedExCup standings, as well as in-season qualifiers via the Aon Next 10 and Aon Swing 5.
